verdict.rationale: Bento serves a live llms.txt and a markdown docs index, which the probes confirmed with HTTP 200. Its docs pages are published as .md files, and it offers agent-oriented material: an AI agent setup journey, Bento Skills guidance that tells the agent which surface to use, and copyable prompts for agents. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these docs successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
